scope: Sum of two source-disjoint 50-image CLI experiments, 10 original photographs total. All within-partition cross-split pairs are scored; cross-partition pairs are not included. Controlled same-source transformations, not natural contamination.
limitations: Only ten curated sources and five held-out sources; no population precision claim.
Many correlated pairs derive from each source; pair counts are not independent sample sizes.
Crops still cause false negatives; no arbitrary rotation, local-object or semantic-leakage coverage.
Wall times are three local alternating runs including Node startup, decode, hashing and output; operation counts are deterministic, timings are not.
